thread:
sam_ux: Quick follow-up from research: when we send onboarding emails with links like https://console/redwood/models#batching users land on the page but the in-product docs panel doesn't open or focus the section. UX friction.
viv_docs: Yep saw this in the support ticket. Docs have stable ids (batching) but the console only parses ?help= currently, not fragments.
raj_frontend: Current behavior: router strips hash on navigation and overlay only opens via internal clicks. Quick fix: on route change, check location.hash and call openDocs(anchor). Also support ?help=anchor for older emails. Estimate 1d.
clare_a11y: If we auto-open overlay on hash, we must move keyboard focus into the modal, set aria-modal="true", and ensure the heading has tabindex="-1" before focusing. Also add aria-live announcement like "Opened Docs: Batching".
sam_ux: Copy note: in-product snippets show "Guide" but console nav says "Docs". Recommend standardize to "Docs". Also tooltip on hover: "Opens Docs and jumps to section".
viv_docs: I'll add stable ids and create an alias map for legacy anchors. Will also update the snippet copy to "Docs" and push a small redirect for old anchors.
raj_frontend: Implementation plan: 1) read anchors.json at app bootstrap and fallback when getElementById fails; 2) on load or route change, if hash present call openDocs(hash) which does history.replaceState(null,'',`#${id}`) and focus; 3) support ?help=anchor too. I'll include aria attributes and a focus trap. Small code sample in PR.
clare_a11y: QA checklist: keyboard-only open, screen reader announces localized heading, focus trap works, back button returns focus to trigger, and no double announcements. Test NVDA/VoiceOver.
ops-bot: CI: docs PR needed before frontend merge to avoid missing ids.
sam_ux: Acceptance criteria: fragments and ?help= work, copy unified to "Docs", a11y attributes + focus behavior, anchors.json deployed with docs artifact. Priority P2.
viv_docs: I'll tag everyone on the docs PR. Raj, please tag accessibility and UX on the frontend PR for signoff.
raj_frontend: Will do. Thanks all. :thumbsup:
